title: How an F1 V8 reaches 19,000 RPM
description: A 2008 Formula One V8 slowed 148×, its firing events turned into a bass house beat, then back to 1,267 bangs a second.
question: How does an F1 V8 reach 19,000 RPM without flying apart?
